Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the time last week. Attached is our first cut at the AWS Marketplace product page copy and a checklist for Private Offer readiness (aws_listing_draft.docx, private_offer_checklist.xlsx, ami_screenshot.png). We tried to keep the microcopy punchy for self-serve discovery while making the private-offer flow clear for procurement.

Quick asks:

- Are the pricing units and usage examples clear for your procurement team (we used per-1k tokens equivalence in the pricing table)?

Kimberly,

Appreciate the draft — this looks promising. A few quick notes from my side (procurement + product):

1) Pricing examples: The per-1k token framing is fine but our procurement team often needs a monthly example tied to concurrent sessions or documents processed. Can you add a sample monthly bill for a 100k tokens/month usage profile?

2) Compliance bullet: Good but please expand the data residency line to explicitly say "data never leaves the customer's VPC for private deployments" — that specific phrasing helps with internal reviewers.

3) AMI label: The screenshot helps. Our internal ops asks that AMI names include the AWS Seller ID and a date stamp (e.g., acme-rl-inference-20261201). Is that something you can add to the AMI export naming convention?

4) Private Offer: We will need a high-level term on support response times in the Private Offer. Can you propose 24/72 SLAs (P1/P2) in the checklist?

I added an inline comment in the attached doc (I commented in the Google copy — link pasted below) and looped in our Partner SA for any technical AMI constraints.

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Draft AWS listing microcopy & private-offer readiness — review ask

Kimberly —

Thanks for looping us in. I pulled Lauren's notes into a quick set of suggested edits (attached as aws_listing_draft_v2.docx). High level:

- Headline: tightened to "High-throughput, production-grade LLM inference" (shorter, benefit-first).
- Feature bullets: reordered to surface cost controls (batching, quantization) before model catalog. Buyers on marketplace skim for cost levers.
- Compliance microcopy: replaced generic line with Lauren's suggested phrasing and added a parenthetical for Private deployment: "(data processing occurs within the customer's VPC for private/private-deployment modes)".
- Pricing example: added a 100k tokens/month example with estimated monthly cost at the sample rate; left note that final numbers depend on model/quantization.
- AMI naming: added suggested convention and a short note for Partner SA on whether Seller ID must be embedded.

I also flagged the support SLA language — suggested P1: 4-hour response (business hours) and P2: 24-hour response. Lauren asked for 24/72; let's decide which we can promise for the marketplace listing vs Private Offer.

On the attachments: I included redline comments directly in aws_listing_draft_v2.docx.

Ben
Ben Carter
Product Marketing | Redwood Inference

Lauren — thanks for the thorough review and quick turnaround. Summary and next steps: 

1) Copy updates: Ben will fold in the pricing example (100k tokens/month) and the data residency phrasing; I expect aws_listing_draft_v2.docx by end of day.
2) AMI naming: Partner SA — please confirm whether the Seller ID must be embedded in the AMI name. Ops (Vanessa) and I will adopt the acme-rl-inference-YYYYMMDD pattern if ok.
3) SLAs & Private Offer: We propose P1=4hr, P2=24hr for the Marketplace listing. For Private Offers we can map to 24/72 if Acme requests that in contract — Vanessa will prepare the Private Offer template and send to Lauren's procurement contact for initial review.
4) Timeline & publish: Target to publish to marketplace by 2027-01-10 if we have final copy by 2026-12-21 and sign-off on AMI tags.

Would you be available for a quick 30-minute sync on Monday 2026-12-21 at 10:00am PT to walk through v2 and the Private Offer checklist? If that works, I will send a calendar invite.

Thanks again — I'll attach the v2 and checklist to the follow-up.

Best,
